summary: int converts a valid integer string to a whole number in a specified base.
documentation: int converts a valid integer string to a whole number in a specified base. A sign and surrounding whitespace are accepted. Decimal-point text is not a valid base-10 integer string.
inputs: An integer string and optional base.
caution: Invalid text raises ValueError. Converting a float instead truncates toward zero; that is a different operation.
scenarios: Convert validated quantity text from a CSV export.
Read a signed integer adjustment from a settings field.
Turn a textual page number into an integer before range checking.
title: Parse a signed quantity
problem: Input is a valid base-10 integer string with optional surrounding ASCII whitespace and a leading + or - sign. Return its integer value, discarding leading zeroes. No decimal points, separators or exponents are supplied.
goal: Use int() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
